items.q: Why does my AWD car need a flatbed?
items.a: Towing an AWD vehicle with two wheels on the ground can strain the drivetrain. A flatbed lifts the whole car.

items.q: Do you have a flatbed available now?
items.a: We run 16 flatbeds, so there's a good chance one is nearby. Call and we'll tell you when it can get to you.

items.q: Can you move a car that doesn't roll?
items.a: Yes. Damaged vehicles and cars with locked wheels are winched onto the bed.
